invariants.rationale: The method parameter 'layer' must be non-null at the exit point as it is dereferenced in the method for field and method calls.
The method returns early if 'layer.getTextureRegion() == null', so at method exit this must be non-null.
'layer.getX()' is called and used in arithmetic; it must be a valid float at exit.
If neither 'layer.isRepeatX()' nor 'layer.isRepeatY()', the only rendering done is if the bounds contain/overlap. Otherwise, repeat rendering is attempted.
The parallax factors are used in an arithmetic expression and likely should be non-negative.
